title: Auto Compressor
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel. Compresses ores automatically.
body:
Created by @TheEpitex YouTube channel, this mod streamlines mining by automatically compressing ores in your inventory, letting you mine longer without constantly worrying about inventory space. It converts nuggets to ingots and ingots to blocks.
